proof_body:
by
  intro f hf hlim
  have hd : ∀ c, deriv f c = 0 := by
    intro c
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < ‖deriv f c‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
    set ε := ‖deriv f c‖ / 4 with hε
    have hε0 : 0 < ε := by positivity
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ‖f z / z‖ < ε := by
      have := (tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mp hlim).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε0)
      exact this
    have hbd : Bornology.IsBounded {z | ‖f z / z‖ < ε}ᶜ := Bornology.isBounded_compl_iff.mpr hev
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mp hbd
    have hbound : ∀ z : ℂ, T < ‖z‖ → ‖f z / z‖ < ε := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra h
      have := hT (show z ∈ {z | ‖f z / z‖ < ε}ᶜ from h)
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at this
      linarith
    set R := |T| + ‖c‖ + 1 with hRdef
    have hR : 0 < R := by positivity
    have hs : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * ε * R := by
      intro z hz
      have hz' : ‖z - c‖ = R := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
      have h1 : R - ‖c‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le z c
        linarith
      have h2 : ‖z‖ ≤ R + ‖c‖ := by
        have := norm_add_le (z - c) c
        simp only [sub_add_cancel] at this
        linarith
      have h3 : T < ‖z‖ := by
        have := le_abs_self T
        linarith
      have h4 : 0 < ‖z‖ := by
        have := abs_nonneg T
        linarith
      have h5 := hbound z h3
      rw [norm_div, div_lt_iff₀ h4] at h5
      have h6 : ‖z‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
        have : ‖c‖ ≤ R := by
          have := abs_nonneg T
          linarith
        linarith
      calc ‖f z‖ ≤ ε * ‖z‖ := h5.le
        _ ≤ ε * (2 * R) := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * ε * R := by ring
    have h7 := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR (hf.diffContOnCl (s := Metric.ball c R)) hs
    have h8 : 2 * ε * R / R = 2 * ε := by field_simp
    rw [h8, hε] at h7
    linarith
  exact fun z w => is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hf hd z w
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Filter.Tendsto (fun z => f z / z) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (nhds 0) → ∀ z w, f z = f w
